samples.prompt: user: My Node service crashes with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined at startup. Where should I look first?
samples.response: I understand how disruptive a startup crash can be. Here's what I can do: First, check the exact line in your startup code where the error occurs—this will pinpoint which variable is undefined. Next, verify that all required environment variables or configuration values are properly set before that line executes. Can you share the snippet around the error line or confirm if any external data is loaded at startup?

samples.prompt: user: My Node service crashes with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined at startup. Where should I look first?
samples.response: Start by identifying the exact line causing the error in your startup code. Check for any variables or objects that might be undefined before accessing their properties. Review your initialization logic to ensure all dependencies and configurations are properly loaded. Use console.log or a debugger to trace variable states step-by-step at startup. Also, verify that any asynchronous operations complete successfully before their results are accessed.
